title: Four years of war in Ukraine: 'Time is on Ukraine’s side', argues an analyst
summary: Ukraine marked the fourth anniversary of Russia's full-scale invasion on Tuesday (February 24). Tens of thousands of lives have been lost since the Kremlin ordered troops into Ukraine on February 24, 2022. For more analysis, FRANCE 24's Carys Garland is joined by Samuel Ramani, associate fellow at the Royal United Services Institute.
